label.description: Instruction and action, such as "Hold to delete project".

onConfirm.description: Called once when the hold completes.

icon.description: Leading icon. Replaced by a drawn check when done.

confirmed.description: Controls the done state. Set back to false to reset; leave undefined to let the button manage it.

onHoldChange.description: Reports when a hold starts and ends, for hints like "Keep holding".
